Here is a Python program to generate a palindrome of length 255:

```python
def create_palindrome(length):
    # Generate first half
    half = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789!@#$%^&*()'
    half_length = len(half)
    first_half = half[:length // 2]
    
    # Create second half as reverse of first half
    second_half = first_half[::-1]

    if length % 2 == 0:
        return first_half + second_half
    else:
        # If length is odd, add one more character from half
        return first_half + half[length // 2] + second_half

print(create_palindrome(255))
```
This Python program generates a palindrome of any given length. It starts by creating the first half of the string, then it reverses this to create the second half. If the length is odd, it also adds one more character from the original half in the middle.

Note: This is not an efficient way to generate large palindromes as it requires storing entire strings up to 255 characters.
